units.source_text: 不过，阿民这种拼命的“挣钱病”似乎完全没有满足的时候。

en.t: However, Amin's desperate money-making sickness seemed never to be satisfied.

units.source_text: 又过了一年，阿民提出将桑田扩展到河对岸的打算。

en.t: Another year passed, and Amin proposed expanding the mulberry fields to the far side of the river.

units.source_text: 据阿民自己说，将近一亩多的土地只能收到十圆的地租，十分不划算。

en.t: According to Amin himself, nearly a mu of land brought in only ten yuan in rent, which was hardly worth it.

units.source_text: 不如将那块地拿回来自己种植桑树，农闲的时候养蚕，

en.t: It would be better to take that plot back, plant mulberry trees on it himself, and raise silkworms during the slack farming season,

units.source_text: 只要蚕茧的行情没有大的变动，一年至少能有一百五十圆的收入。

en.t: and as long as cocoon prices did not fluctuate greatly, it could bring in at least one hundred and fifty yuan a year.

units.source_text: 但是无论如何需要钱，只要想到要为了赚钱更加辛苦操劳，阿住实在难以接受。

en.t: But although they needed money no matter what, Azhu simply could not bear the thought of working even harder just to earn more.

units.source_text: 尤其是养蚕这种费时费力的事情，两个人每次商量都很难达成共识。

en.t: Especially with something as time-consuming and laborious as raising silkworms, the two of them could never easily agree whenever they discussed it.

units.source_text: 阿住最后忍不住用抱怨的语气，抗议阿民：

en.t: At last Azhu could not hold back and protested to Amin in a complaining tone:
It is not that I want to shirk the work.

units.source_text: 但是如果不推脱的话，家里一个男人也没有，还有一个黏人的孩子，

en.t: But if I do not turn it down, there is not a single man in the house, and there is also a clingy child,

units.source_text: 现况我已经令我难以喘息了。

en.t: and things as they are already leave me unable to catch my breath.

units.source_text: 你竟然还想养蚕，怎么可能做到呢？

en.t: And you still want to raise silkworms; how could that possibly be done?

units.source_text: 你也顾虑下我的情况啊！”

en.t: Please think about my situation too!"
